_comment: Emitted alongside id.crt/id.key by the cert-mint step (mkcert + crypto/x509 leaves). The envoy sidecar's init parses this once at startup and writes the RBAC config. Cert rotation rotates this file. Prod target migrates the same payload into x509 custom OIDs. See docs/TODO.md Aspirational: App-tier cert as the access-policy carrier.
